excerpt: I usually understand the graph first, but I wait because I need time to make the English sentence sound correct.
When the question has many words, I forget which biology idea the graph is testing.
Drawing arrows helps me explain before I find the exact English word.
If I can discuss with a partner first, I know what I want to say in English.
Sometimes I know the answer but I am not sure if the teacher wants a full sentence or just the evidence.
Numbers are easier than explaining why the pattern happens.
I use Korean in my notes, then I translate the science idea after I understand it.
When the teacher gives sentence starters, I answer faster, but I still want to choose my own evidence.
